title: Provider-neutral Forge seam: GitHub adapter, in-memory double, and the Report step
summary: This change introduces a provider-neutral `Forge` trait as the seam between the factory and a code host, and moves all process-spawning `gh` code out of the pure `review` and `pr_status` modules into a new `github` adapter that implements it. A `FakeForge` test double records every call as plain data and can script answers or failures, and a new `report_change` step runs the pull-request lifecycle (open, write status block, read capabilities, post review, read checks) in one fixed order. The existing `osf review post`, `osf pr status apply` and `osf pr status refresh` commands now go through the adapter instead of shelling out directly, with behavior pinned by new characterization tests against a fake `gh` on PATH.
